Working backward from \(\frac{19}{87}\):

\[
\frac{19}{87}\to \frac{87}{19}\to \frac{68}{19}\to \frac{49}{19}\to \frac{30}{19}\to \frac{11}{19}\to \frac{19}{11}\to \frac{8}{11}\to \frac{11}{8}\to \frac{3}{8}\to \frac{8}{3}\to \frac{5}{3}\to \frac{2}{3}\to \frac{3}{2}\to \frac{1}{2}\to 2\to 1.
\]

Tracking the index operations backward:

\[
n\to n-1\to \frac{n-1}{2}\to \cdots \to \frac{n-881}{1024}.
\]

Since this final index is \(1\),

\[
\frac{n-881}{1024}=1 \implies n=1905.
\]

The digit sum is

\[
1+9+0+5=15.
\]

\[
\boxed{15}
\]
